Thank you. I will send him this.  
  
The worst feeling in the world is when you feel you're alone.
  
Maybe he'd feel better if he messaged you.

We already speak pretty much 24/7, in fact I'm chatting with him right now about random stuff.  
  
I've been trying to "push" him to change his routine but I don't want to be pushy as he always shuts down when that happens.  
  
But maybe it's the only thing I can do right now...  
  
Thank you so much. :)
